data.source: `@dynamicfx 1@graphpass gen: input -> apass copy: a -> output@end@pass gen// acceptance 010c-ui-source-envelope// @param gain label:"Gain" min:0 max:2 default:0.25struct FxUniforms {u_resolution:vec2<f32>,u_time:f32,u_frame:f32,gain:f32,}@@group(0) @binding(2) var<uniform> fx:FxUniforms;@@fragment fn main()->@location(0) vec4<f32>{return vec4<f32>(fx.gain,0.4,0.6,1.0);}@endpass@pass copystruct FxUniforms {u_resolution:vec2<f32>,u_time:f32,u_frame:f32,}@@group(0) @binding(0) var u_input:texture_2d<f32>;@@group(0) @binding(1) var u_sampler:sampler;@@group(0) @binding(2) var<uniform> fx:FxUniforms;@@fragment fn main(@location(0) v_uv:vec2<f32>)->@location(0) vec4<f32>{return textureSample(u_input,u_sampler,v_uv);}@endpass`;0
